regime_context: US thematic landscape is broad and only mildly concentrated: 22 of 49 themes are trend-gate eligible, no single narrative dominates, and absorption is low (0.30). The top momentum names are attention leaders only — 'Memory, HBM & Storage' ranks first but is ineligible (durability 0.24, breadth 0.0) while the actual gate-eligible leader is 'Non-AI Software' (trend, broad, but crowded). Given dir_accuracy of 0.44 against a 0.611 hit rate, I weight direction modestly, keep convictions low, and avoid the documented failure mode of fading the crowded leader.
emerging_watch: Watching whether 'Non-AI Software' (currently crowded at z=1.45 and the gate-eligible leader) shows a CONFIRMED leadership handoff: if IGV prints a lower low on the weekly chart while Cybersecurity (CIBR) or Big Pharma (PPH) simultaneously makes a higher relative high against SPY, that would signal software leadership is fading and retire this watch.

theses.subject: Non-AI Software
theses.thesis: The strongest gate-eligible theme: durable trend (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.74), broad participation (breadth 0.857), and rotation challenger status behind an ineligible leader. Supported by the absolute-trend gate (the one validated risk-control leg) and high cohesion. The crowding_z of 1.45 is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, not a fade — per guardrails this supports the trend but calls for restraint.
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z 1.45 (cap exposure, do not fade)
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding (z=1.45) historically marks late-stage attention; thematic-ETF inflow spikes mark tops, and with dir_accuracy only 0.44 the directional edge is thin — the very trend the gate validates may be closer to exhaustion than continuation.

falsifier.text: IGV breaks below its own 50-day average and underperforms SPY by more than 8% before the 30-day check-by date

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: A second durable, gate-eligible software theme with the same trend signature as Non-AI Software (hurst_tag trend, durability_bar 0.76, breadth 0.70). It shares the sector leadership but is even more crowded (z=1.58). The trend-gate leg supports participation; crowding again caps rather than forbids.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z is the second-highest in the eligible set — flow concentration here is extreme, and the guardrail explicitly warns not to treat attention spikes as buys; the software complex may be one overcrowded narrative cluster rotating together.

falsifier.text: CIBR falls more than 10% relative to the S&P 500 within the next 30 trading days

theses.subject: Big Pharma
theses.thesis: Highest durability_bar in the eligible set (0.80) with hurst 'trend' and very broad participation (0.889). Big Pharma represents a defensive-adjacent trend separate from the crowded software complex, giving diversification. The trend-gate risk-control leg is the strongest here; crowding (z=1.25) is high but less extreme than software peers.
evidence: eligible=true with durability_bar 0.80 (top in eligible set)
crowded=true but crowding_z 1.25 (more moderate than software themes)
theses.dissent: The macro backdrop shows unscheduled share of 1.0 — surprise-driven policy/geo headlines dominate, and defensive/healthcare trends can reverse hard on a single policy surprise; a trend gate that helped historically does not insulate against an idiosyncratic macro shock.

falsifier.text: PPH underperforms SPY by more than 6% over the next 20 trading days

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
